source: 17 user supplied October 2025 Google Street View screenshots, ordered along Vidyanagar Road No. 2
usage: Visual reference only. No screenshot imagery used as textures. Camera points establish viewing sequence, not building centroids.

segments.observations: Rusty blue entrance posts, faded white panel, narrow paved lane, single-storey pale blue/cream houses close to left, corrugated roof edges, grilles, right compound wall and trees
Lane opens into wide tree-lined setbacks; single-storey quarters, low walls, gates, soil/grass shoulders, occasional roadside drainage; preserve open space rather than filling it with buildings
Narrower lane again; taller pale blue dwelling on right, exposed brick parapet, steps, gates, porch roofs, dense vegetation on left
Closely spaced low houses, pale green/cream/blue walls, corrugated porches, blue awnings, roof water tanks, ventilation blocks, laundry and plants

unknowns: Exact road/building dimensions, hidden geometry, parcel boundaries and individual source-building bindings. Remaining sequence extends beyond entrance way and must be matched before changing geometry.
implementation_status: Entrance aligned to mapped junction/lane; 4-segment street replica (compound walls, gates, corrugated porches, authentic pale blue/cream/mint facades, water tanks, and setback trees) generated and integrated via VidyaNagarTwoStreetBuilder.
